Mode fulldev_eval_d13_v3w_s1of2: SHARD 1 of 2 of fulldev_eval_d13_v3w (D13 job-hjwpq art-cr9a2 best step 1600, joint_record head, readout v3w UNTEMPERED, max_input_tokens 65536; everything else identical). Why sharded: the one-job run expects ~500 of a 536-min phase cap (the live guard stops past 0.95 x cap, i.e. a box > 1.8 % slower than the screen) and a stopped run loses every scored row. Rows = shard 1 of jobs/m2_first_cell/fulldev_shards_2.json (pre-declared: harness.cases case clusters never split, sha256(seed:case_id) mod 2, token-balanced; ids_sha256 5aa8ef1531b4c171f34b6b8174fc04c3ec3e8c28eb4ba396663e605432bb86fe, 6109 rows, 4191 clusters, 11,315,055 v1 tokens); the job rebuilds the plan from its DEV rows and exits 10 on any difference. Expected: 11,315,055 x 0.9004 x 1.2513 s/1k = 212.5 min scoring + 33 fixed (load + 150k lineage) + the plan pass on this shard's rows only (42 x 0.5000 = 21.0) = 266.5 min; fulldev cap 336 = 26.1 % headroom (the guard tolerates a box 19.8 % slower). max_duration 370 (setup 12 / guard 3 / checkpoint 7 / fulldev 336 / report 5 / reserve 7): quoted hold $23.31, worst case $39.6 (cap $60). On ANY exit the partial rows ($CK/fulldev/child.partial.jsonl + identity) are copied into the phase export; a follow-up job resumes them via env SEED_PARTIAL_URL + SEED_PARTIAL_SHA256 (identity-checked). Land: fulldev_eval merge <s1 fulldev dir> <s2 fulldev dir> --out <dir>/fulldev/child.results.jsonl, then analysis/land_fulldev.py --art <dir>.
